summary: SPE-4794 companion C-2+C-1 on desk_receipt_approve, hard-fixed against Greptile 3/5: fail closed when the tip can't be resolved instead of silently disabling the C-2 guard, gate the stamped candidate with check_receipt strict=True (not False), and this receipt's own claims now cite evidence_command_index instead of free-text evidence. Second hard-fix round (tip_match 3/5): replaced this receipt's own unescaped-bracket grep (recorded exit 0, actually exits 1) with a fixed-string grep -F that genuinely exits 0, and closed a second TOCTOU gap in _commit_file — the clone-time tip compare guarded expect_sha, but the actual push to the branch was unconditional, so a rewind landing between the clone and the push could still fast-forward and resurrect content the rewind removed. The push is now itself gated with --force-with-lease on the tip _commit_file observed at clone time, with a ls-remote fallback to report stale_read (not a raw push error) when the lease rejects. Does not edit programming-desk #40.

commands.cmd: grep -nF 'await repo.receipt_check(candidate, candidate.get("bot") or "", True, args["receipt_path"])' services/desk-gateway/src/desk_gateway/tools/quality.py

claims.claim: quality.py parses as valid Python 3 after the tip-check + strict=True hard-fix and the new push-side lease guard

receipt_approve gates the stamped candidate through check_receipt with strict=True, not strict=False (fixed-string grep -F match on the live source line; the prior bracket-unescaped grep in this same receipt recorded exit 0 but actually exits 1)

receipt_approve's first-stamp path (C-1) stamps approved_by/approved_at and pushes when the receipt's claims cite evidence_command_index and G-2/G-3/G-5-6 pass in strict mode, against a real bare git remote
check_receipt (G-2) refuses a claim that cites free-text 'evidence' instead of evidence_command_index with gate_failed, and the branch tip is left unmoved
_commit_file (C-2 TOCTOU) refuses the push with stale_read and leaves the remote branch tip unchanged when it moved after the receipt was read (read-to-clone race)

_commit_file's final push is itself conditional on the tip observed at clone time: when the branch is rewound to an ancestor between the internal clone and the internal push, the force-with-lease push is rejected and _commit_file reports stale_read instead of fast-forwarding over the rewind (clone-to-push race)
the full desk-gateway test suite (103 tests, including these 4 regressions) passes with no other regressions

unverified: no live desk_receipt_approve call against the deployed gateway process; all coverage here is direct unit calls to quality.receipt_approve/_commit_file against a local bare git remote built in tmp_path

the read_sha is None fail-closed guard (added alongside the strict-True fix) has no dedicated regression test: Repo.resolve_ref falls back to HEAD rather than surfacing None for an unresolvable ref, so triggering the None path without also changing resolve_ref is out of scope for this hard-fix
